schema_description: Source-scoped human biomonitoring sidecar. Each record is an independently located source-reported summary, effect estimate or model weight; no value is a product-occurrence measurement. Null values represent censored/absent information, never zero. This file does not itself authorize numeric promotion.

evidence_fitness.population: Girls aged 4–8 years; six Spanish hospitals; recruitment 2018–2022
supports: Human urinary exposure distributions (source-native medians and detection frequencies)
Associations with contemporaneous early puberty diagnoses
cannot_support: Causal claims or longitudinal puberty timing
HMTc limits or product contamination profiles
evidence_fitness.numeric_extraction_confidence: high for visually verified main-PDF tables; supplement gaps disclosed

HUVA.zero_note: Absence of controls explicitly stated in Methods.

methods.metals: Agilent 8900 triple quadrupole ICP-MS; no speciation described in main paper
methods.storage: Polypropylene containers; frozen at -80 °C before analysis at University of Granada
methods.dilution: Specific gravity measured by handheld refractometer for dilution adjustment; exact formula unavailable in main PDF
methods.continuous_models: Natural-log transformed biomarkers with detection frequency >85%; authors express effect per doubling
methods.mixture: BPA, MeP, BP-3, As, Cu, Hg, Ni, Zn; quartile g-computation; 1000 bootstraps

gaps.scope: Detailed sample preparation, blanks, certified-reference material/recovery/precision results, all element LOD/LOQs, exact SG correction, sums definition, Tables S1-S8 and Figures S1-S6
gaps.reason: Referenced supplement is not embedded in the 13-page main PDF. It was not opened within this bounded PDF slice.
gaps.action: Retrieve supplement in a later bounded source-repair pass; main-PDF extraction remains usable with these limitations.

gaps.scope: Individual participant urine measurements, exact recruitment dates by hospital, within-Spain regional metal concentrations
gaps.reason: Main PDF reports summary data and recruitment years 2018–2022; data available on request. No regional/time-trend concentrations are reported.
gaps.action: Retain source-native summaries; no imputed participant values or regional breakdown.

gaps.scope: Exact Cd, Cu, Pb, Mn, Ni, tAs, tHg categorical odds ratios and their CIs, and Figure 2 component weights not stated in text
gaps.reason: Figures contain points/bars without numeric annotations. Exact values cannot be transcribed from plot positions.
gaps.action: Retain qualitative directions only; Zn third-tertile estimate 2.28 (1.10–4.73) is available in text. No fabricated precision or visual approximation.

adjudication_trace.decision: Remove sunscreen/fish occurrence routes and US geography

adjudication_trace.decision: Keep Cd inverse association descriptive and uncertain
adjudication_trace.reason: Categorical observational association; cannot infer cadmium is protective.
